messages:
sarah: Observability alert — sudden tail latency spike on /v1/generate in us-west1 around 02:12. graphs show increased p99 and a bunch of 502s.
infra-alert-bot: Detected node terminations in pool mixed-gpu-fast-usw1 (preemptible). 14 nodes drained in last 3m.
james: Confirming - I'm seeing eviction events and reconnect churn. KV cache miss rate jumped ~8x.
alex: Speculatively high eviction rate from the cloud provider auction in usw1-a. Pool mix is 70% preemptible, 30% on-demand.
maria: TL;DR: requests hitting cold-starts + cache misses = latency. We should reduce batch windows and failover to on-demand ASAP.
sarah: Oncall: can we temporarily shift traffic to dedicated-reserved for critical routes (chat/generation)? Need minimal blast radius. @ops-runbooks runbook?
ops-runbooks: Runbook start: 1) Scale up reserved-capacity ASG in usw1 to +20 nodes. 2) Route /v1/generate (priority=true) to reserved pool via routing policy. 3) Reduce batch_max_tokens to 64 for 10m.
james: Starting scale-up now: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize rg-reserved-usw1 --size 20`
kevin: I'll flip routing rules in the proxy: add weight to reserved pool, drain from mixed pool. Doing a gradual 20->60% shift.
alex: Noted cost hit, but necessary. Heads up: unit cost expected to rise ~1.35x while this runs.
maria: Also rolling a quick config to lower batching: `RENDER_BATCH_MAX=64` and `BATCH_WAIT_MS=10` to reduce tail.
sarah: Anyone see errors in the model container logs? I'm seeing repeated KV lookup timeouts before eviction. snippet:
```
2026-03-18T02:13:01Z model-789 error kv:get failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-18T02:13:02Z model-782 warn cache:miss warmup triggered
```
kevin: Cache warmup is expensive when nodes drop. Good call to reduce batch and rely on on-demand.
james: Scale-up completed, reserved ASG at +20. Proxy weights moved 55% reserved / 45% mixed. Latency p99 dropped 60% already.
infra-alert-bot: Incident metric: p99 generation latency peaked 3.8s -> current 1.2s. Error rate down to baseline.
alex: Next steps: 1) Investigate cloud auction telemetry with provider (why this burst). 2) Revisit mixed-pool ratio and graceful-drain timeout. Current drain timeout is 30s — maybe increase to 90s to give KV warmup.
maria: Also add a small grace cache layer in front of model to absorb spikes (hot-prefix cache). Low-memory LRU on reserved nodes only.
sarah: I want a postmortem item to evaluate cost delta and decide if we temporarily reduce preemptible fraction for critical regions. Also add synthetic prompt sets to detect KV-warmup pain.
kevin: Will schedule follow-up doc and add temporary budget alert for reserved spend.
james: For immediate rollback: we keep reserved weight until provider confirms auction calmed. Re-enable mixed pool at 10% increments.
ops-runbooks: Marking incident resolved (partial mitigation). Closing notes: root cause = sudden preemptible eviction wave in usw1 lowering effective cache heat and increasing cold-start tail.
sarah: :thumbsup: Good job team. Postmortem owners: alex (cloud liaison), maria (cache design), kevin (routing + cost).
